description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya Central, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (23/0122)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels in the Matara District under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owners' details, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters.
